title: Salesforce Disables Klue App Integration After OAuth Token Abuse Exposes Customer Data
summary: Salesforce has revealed that it disabled the Klue Battlecards app integration within its platform in response to a security incident impacting the competitive intelligence company on June 11, 2026.

title: Apple Patches Beats Studio Buds Flaw Letting Nearby Attackers Spy via Microphone
summary: Apple has updated its Beats Studio Buds wireless earbuds to patch a high-severity vulnerability that could be exploited by nearby hackers to eavesdrop on users.
